crossRefs.note: His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind.
The women sang to one another as they played, and said, “Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.”
They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, Yahweh’s saint.
Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?
Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after…
Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people, and be disappointed.…
For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.
But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled…
“The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him,
But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by…
Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?
Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?
